ios.desc:
Whether you are a lover of classic literature or want an easy way to incorporate more reading into your life, this app makes for wonderful listening. From The Great Gatsby to the Wizard of Oz, listening is one tap away. If you’re on the go without internet access, download audiobooks to your phone to listen anywhere. The app saves your progress and history, so you can hop in and out without losing track of your place.

You will appreciate the features and functionality of Librivox Library. All of the works are entirely free to access. Unlike a traditional library, you don’t need to wait. You can access and download any book at any time.

Features:
* Home screen showing book options and cover art
* Instant play access with the push of a button
* Preview a book description before you start listening with descriptions that contain title, author, cover art, language, tags, download size, duration, summary, and chapter headings
* Download any books to your phone for offline listening
* Floating book player allows you to continue browsing as you listen
* Navigation buttons in book player allow you to quickly rewind and fast forward or jump between chapters
* Browse by author and language tags
* Craft your own personal library that saves your downloads and listening history
* Player will continue in the background on your phone and will pick up where last paused


Popular Books Available In English Include:
- Jane Eyre by Charlotte Bronte
- Little Women by Louisa May Alcott
- The Art of War by Sun Tzu
- Dracula by Bram Stoker
- The Picture of Dorian Gray by Oscar Wilde
- Frankenstein by Mary Shelley
- Pride and Prejudice by Jane Austen
- The Adventures of Huckleberry Finn by Mark Twain
- Crime and Punishment by Fyodor Dostoyevsky
- A Christmas Carol by Charles Dickens
- The Odyssey by Homer
- Don Quixote by Miguel de Cervantes
- Moby Dick by Herman Melville
- The Wonderful Wizard of Oz by L Frank Baum

You can also access audiobooks in below Languages:
- English
- German
- Spanish
- French
- Dutch
- Portuguese
- Italian
- Russian
- Japanese

This public domain content was made possible by LibriVox organization.

A subscription gives you instant access to over 17,000 audiobooks through a powerful search tool that allows you to navigate based on title, author, or description.
